title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks

  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

title: Staff Data Scientist

Cientista de Dados

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos

  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. title: Latin America Sales Manager
description:
Latin America Sales Manager


Location: Argentina or Brazil (remote with frequent regional travel)

Languages: Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; English required


Role Overview

The Latin America Sales Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the commercial strategy across key Latin American markets, with a strong focus on distributor management, retail execution, and market expansion. This role combines strategic planning with hands-on execution, building channel structures, managing key partners, driving sell-in and sell-out performance, and ensuring strong brand and product positioning at retail level. The ideal candidate has experience operating in fragmented distribution environments and scaling businesses across multiple LATAM markets.


Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Market Development

- Define and execute the LATAM sales strategy by country and channel.

- Identify priority markets, key accounts, and go-to-market models adapted to local realities.

- Build annual business plans, forecasts, and revenue targets by country and partner.

- Drive structured market expansion while maintaining margin discipline.


Distributor & Retail Management

- Select, onboard, and manage distributors across Latin America.

- Lead commercial negotiations including pricing, margins, assortments, and commercial terms.

- Develop joint business plans with distributors and key retail partners.

- Ensure strong in-store execution including assortment, merchandising, promotions, and training.

- Monitor inventory levels, sell-in vs sell-out, and corrective actions to avoid overstock.


Sales Execution & Performance Management

- Own regional sales targets including revenue, volume, and product mix.

- Track KPIs such as sell-in, sell-out, ASP, and inventory turns.

- Coordinate promotional calendars and seasonal programs with partners.

- Work closely with marketing and GTM teams to adapt tools and messaging locally.


Cross-Functional Coordination

- Act as the LATAM point of contact for supply chain, marketing, after-sales, and finance teams.

- Align demand forecasting with supply planning to support seasonality.

- Provide structured market feedback on products, pricing, competition, and customer needs.



Preferred Backgrounds

- Pool equipment distribution (pool cleaners, pumps, pool accessories).

- Consumer electronics or durable consumer goods with strong retail exposure.


Experience & Qualifications Required

- 7–12+ years of sales experience in Latin America with regional responsibility.

- Proven experience managing distributors and retail accounts.

- Strong understanding of retail execution and sell-out driven models.

- Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; professional working level of English.

- Experience working with international or multinational companies.

- Willingness to travel frequently across LATAM.


Strong Plus

- Experience launching or scaling brands in Latin America.

- Background in seasonal or high-ticket consumer products.

- Experience balancing modern retail, traditional retail, and distributors.

- Data-driven mindset with experience using CRM, BI, or sales reporting tools.


Profile & Soft Skills

- Entrepreneurial and self-driven; comfortable building markets from scratch.

- Strong negotiator with solid commercial judgment.

- Structured, execution-focused, and reliable.

- Culturally agile and comfortable working across multiple LATAM markets.

- Able to operate autonomously while aligning with global HQ strategy.


What Success Looks Like (First 12–18 Months)

- Clear distributor structure in priority LATAM markets.

- Consistent sell-in growth supported by improving sell-out performance.

- Strong retail presence with controlled inventory and margin discipline.

- Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.

- LATAM positioned as a scalable and repeatable growth region.

Principais Atribuições

  • Prospecção ativa (Hunter) e abertura de relacionamento com clientes Upper Middle Market ou Corporate.
  • Originação, estruturação e fechamento de operações de crédito corporativo ;
  • Atuação como Relationship Manager / Corporate Banker , com visão consultiva e foco em geração de valor;
  • Gestão e acompanhamento do pipeline comercial (Funil de Vendas, CRM, Forecast) ;
  • Condução de negociações comerciais complexas , alinhando risco, retorno e estratégia;
  • Interface constante com áreas internas como Crédito, Risco, Produtos, Jurídico, Backoffice e Compliance;
  • Contribuição ativa na definição da estratégia, modelo comercial e posicionamento do segmento Upper Middle ou Corporate.
  • Monitoramento de mercado, concorrência e oportunidades em Corporate Banking ou Middle Market Finance .


Principais requisitos:

  • Certificação CPA‑20 ativa (obrigatória) ;
  • Vivência como:
  • Banker Upper Middle
  • Corporate Banker
  • Relationship Manager Corporate / Middle Market
  • Gerente de Relacionamento Empresas / Corporate


  • Sólido conhecimento em produtos de crédito bancário , como:
  • Capital de Giro
  • Crédito estruturado
  • Operações Bilaterais e Sindicadas
  • Produtos de Atacado / Corporate Finance
  • Histórico comprovado em originação de novos negócios (Hunter) ;
  • Forte perfil comercial consultivo, relacional e negociador , com acesso a decisores (C‑level, CFO, empresários);
  • Capacidade de navegar em ambientes regulados e com governança robusta.


Diferenciais:

  • Atuação anterior em Corporate Banking, Middle Market ou Atacado ;
  • Experiência em expansão ou construção de carteiras/squads comerciais ;
  • Vivência em bancos, instituições financeiras ou plataformas de crédito corporativo;
  • Visão estratégica combinada com execução comercial intensa.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Pre-Sales Consultant - Physical AI - Brazil
description:
We are seeking a technically fluent Pre-Sales Consultant to join our Physical AI Solutions team. In this role you will serve as the connective tissue between prospective customers and our delivery organization, translating complex robotics and autonomous-systems requirements into compelling, commercially viable solution proposals. You will work across our three core service lines ADAS Data Collection & Labeling, Robotics Data Collection & Labeling, Computer Vision data solutions to shape deals that accelerate the development of ADAS systems, vision-language-action (VLA) models, and sim-to-real transfer pipelines.


Key Responsibilities


• Solution Design & Scoping: Partner with prospects to understand their robotics model-training pipelines (VLM pre-training, VLA fine-tuning, RL alignment) and design data collection & labeling solutions that map to each stage.

• Technical Discovery: Lead technical discovery sessions covering sensor modalities (LiDAR, radar, camera, IMU), annotation taxonomies (3D bounding boxes, semantic segmentation, 6-DoF pose), and simulation requirements (Isaac Sim, Real2Sim asset creation).

• Proposal Development: Author technical proposals, SOWs, and RFP/RFI responses that articulate data pipelines, quality frameworks, tooling (e.g., proprietary labeling platforms), and delivery timelines.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Delivery, and Product teams to validate feasibility, refine pricing models, and ensure smooth handoff from pre-sales to production.

• Market Intelligence: Stay current on robotics industry trends, foundation models, sim-to-real transfer, egocentric AI, 3D kinematics, reinforcement learning and feed insights back into go-to-market strategy.

• Customer Presentations & Demos: Develop and deliver tailored presentations, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and workshop sessions for technical and executive audiences.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role within data services, AI/ML, or robotics.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Strong understanding of autonomous driving and/or robotics data pipelines: sensor fusion, data collection at scale, annotation workflows, and quality assurance.

• Familiarity with machine learning model-training workflows, including data curation, labeling taxonomies, and evaluation metrics.

• Experience with at least two of: LiDAR point-cloud processing, camera/image annotation, 3D reconstruction, or simulation environments.

• Proven ability to translate complex technical requirements into clear proposals and commercial terms.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to both engineers and business teams.


Preferred Qualifications


• Direct experience with ADAS or L2–L5 autonomous driving programs at an OEM, Tier-1, or technology partner.

• Hands-on exposure to VLMs, VLAs, or sim-to-real transfer techniques.

• Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or equivalent robotics simulation platforms.

• Experience scoping egocentric data collection projects (AR/VR headsets, wearable sensors).

• Prior work at a Robotics, ADAS or AI training-data company.

• Master’s degree or higher in a relevant technical discipline.


What We Offer


• A front-row seat to the Physical AI revolution, working with leading robotics and autonomous vehicle companies worldwide.

• Competitive base salary.

• Comprehensive benefits package.

• Flexible remote-first culture.


**At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity. Please send us your complete resume in English.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems

  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes

Company Description

Role Overview

Our client is seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer  to lead the transition from manual regression testing to fully automated execution in CI/CD. This is a hands-on role with clear ownership: build, stabilize, and run automated regression suites using Katalon Studio , fully integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines .

You’ll work across two enterprise web applications built with Angular (front end)  and C#/.NET (back end) , hosted in AWS and Azure . The expectation is not just writing tests, but owning execution reliability, test data strategy, and automation standards while mentoring a manual QA team.

Katalon Automation & CI/CD

  • Build, refactor, and maintain automated regression suites in Katalon Studio
  • Execute Katalon tests in CI/CD pipelines  using Azure DevOps
  • Configure pipeline stages, triggers, and pass/fail quality gates
  • Troubleshoot CI-only failures (environment variables, drivers, headless execution)

Test Design & Stability

  • Convert recorded tests into maintainable, production-ready automation
  • Reduce test flakiness through robust selectors, waits, retries, and refactoring
  • Design reusable components, custom keywords, and data-driven tests

Test Data & Environments

  • Establish repeatable staging test data strategies  (seeding, teardown, isolation)
  • Address data collisions in shared environments
  • Coordinate API/UI automation for setup and validation

Mentorship & Standards

  • Upskill manual QA engineers transitioning into automation
  • Define automation standards, structure, and documentation
  • Conduct code reviews and guide best practices

Reporting & Metrics

  • Publish test results and trends in Azure DevOps
  • Track automation KPIs (coverage, pass rate, flakiness)
  • Communicate automation progress and risks to leadership



Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of QA Automation Engineering  experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Katalon Studio
  • Proven experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines  (Azure DevOps strongly preferred)
  • Experience automating Angular web applications
  • Solid understanding of REST API testing
  • Experience designing test data strategies  for non-prod environments
  • Comfortable writing maintainable automation code (Groovy/Java concepts)



Preferred Experience

  • Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and dashboards
  • AWS and Azure-hosted applications
  • C#/.NET application familiarity
  • Parallelized test execution
  • Experience mentoring or leading QA automation efforts
  • LIMS or other regulated enterprise systems (nice to have)



What Success Looks Like

  • Automated regression suites running reliably on every deployment
  • Reduced manual regression effort and release risk
  • Stable, maintainable Katalon test library the team can extend
  • Clear visibility into automation health and coverage

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Salesforce CRM Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.

This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.


Key Responsibilities:


Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):

Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.

Client Journey:

Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.

Data Segmentation and Hygiene:

Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.

Testing & Quality Control:

Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.

Performance & Reporting:

Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.

Operational Support:

Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Platform Integrations:

Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.


Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud

Ability to work on-site at the company’s headquarters at least 4 days per week


Preferred Qualifications:

Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

About Us

Prime Insights connects millions of users worldwide through our proprietary market research panel apps. Our technology powers a global community, delivering a world-class experience for members and actionable, data-driven insights for clients.

We’re building the next generation of our product ecosystem with AI at its core. Our mission is simple: use cutting-edge technology to create better user experiences and smarter business outcomes. We move fast, experiment often, and value people who build, test, and iterate.


Overview

We run a portfolio of rewarded apps used by millions of people, and we use AI to produce the creative that acquires them. We're looking for someone who sees AI tools the way a craftsperson sees their workshop — not as a shortcut, but as a way to make better things faster. You'll produce across formats: playable ads, UGC videos, animated gameplays, motion graphics, and statics. The through-line is taste. The output is yours.


What you'll produce

  • Playable ads - HTML5 interactive ads via our in-house AI generator
  • UGC video - AI-generated or AI-directed scripts, hooks, and edits
  • Animated gameplay - motion-based app demo ads and screen recordings
  • Statics & motion - banner ads, animated creatives, app store assets


What you'll own

  • Generating and art directing assets across formats using AI image, video, and motion tools
  • Running our playable ad generator - concepting mechanics, reviewing output, shipping network variants
  • Maintaining quality across a high volume of creative - knowing when something is ready and when it needs another pass
  • Staying sharp on what's working - feeding performance signals back into your creative decisions


You might be a fit if

  • You have a strong visual sensibility - you notice when something's slightly off and you fix it before anyone asks
  • You're fluent with AI creative tools - different LLM’s, Veo3, NanoBanana, Runway, Kling, Sora, or whatever's best for a specific task in hand
  • You've made things across multiple formats - not just one medium - and you can show us the decisions behind them
  • You're comfortable owning output end-to-end in a small, fast-moving team


Your Background

You come from a creative discipline - video editing, motion design, graphic design, art direction, or something adjacent. You know what good looks like because you've spent time making things, not just prompting things. AI tools are an extension of that craft, not a replacement for it.

  • Video editor — you understand pacing, hooks, and what makes a cut land
  • Motion designer or animator — you have a feel for timing, transitions, and visual rhythm
  • Graphic designer or art director — you compose, you direct, you know when to stop
  • Any combination of the above — the through-line is a trained eye


Nice to have

  • Background in mobile gaming, casual apps, or performance marketing creative
  • Familiarity with UA networks — AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, Google UAC
  • Some comfort reading or debugging HTML and JavaScript


Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer - Ecosystem


We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the Ecosystem team, responsible for the deployment, operation, and reliability of the NaaS platform infrastructure. You will manage the Kubernetes clusters, GitOps pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code, monitoring/alarming frameworks that underpin a multi-environment telecommunications automation platform.

  • Deploy, operate, monitor, and maintain Kubernetes clusters hosting NaaS components (NetBox, Itential, Paragon, CI/CD workers, operators, ingest, kafka, APIGWs, collectors, databases etc...)

  • Manage Vault administration for secrets management, and centralised credential lifecycle across all NaaS components
  • Develop and maintain Helm charts and (deprecated) Ansible playbooks for component deployment and upgrades

  • Design, implement and maintain homogenous telemetry and observability solutions which provide crucial insights to platform health


Key Skills (Required):

  • Linux systems expertise (internals, debugging, performance tuning)
